# Loops inside methods are skipped unless -methods is given.

loopvec .
! stdout .
! stderr .

loopvec -methods .
cmp stdout ops_simd.go.want
cmpenv stderr stderr.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

type T struct{}

func (T) AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

type T struct{}

func (T) AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
		_v2, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(b[_i:])
		_v1.Add(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
